resources.string: Aggregated notifications held during your morning goal

These alerts were removed from your status bar while the morning gate was on. Android does not let apps put them back in the shade — tap an item to open that app, or dismiss the log when you are done.
Tap dismiss when you are ready to start your morning.
Allow exact alarms so the wake-up time is reliable.
Allow full-screen alarms so the wake-up screen can appear over the lock screen.

Morning Guard reads the app name, title, and text of notifications it holds, stores them on this phone, and shows them in the digest after your goal. It does not upload that text. Calls and text messages are not held.
I understand how Morning Guard uses notification access

Bible highlights sync across devices. Reflection notes are always encrypted; set a recovery password in Settings so you can open them on a new phone. Verse excerpts and highlight metadata are not encrypted. Notification text stays on this phone.
We\'ll email a one-time sign-in link for Morning Guard (cloud sync only). The message may come from Supabase; after you tap the link you\'ll see the Morning Guard sign-in page, then the app.
